effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 2+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Chitinous Legs** is 6.
This unit can pass across terrain features as if it had **FLY**.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** within 1" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **SPIDERFANG WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
While a friendly **Snarlboss** is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that **Snarlboss** have **WARD (5+)**.

units.notes_en: You can include 1 unit of this type for each **Snarlboss** in your army. This unit cannot be reinforced.

wargear.en: ***1 model is armed with a Grot Bow and Snarlfang’s Slavering Jaws, and 1 model is armed with a Stabbin’ Stikka and Snarlfang’s Slavering Jaws.***

effect.en: If this unit’s **Zarbag** is on the battlefield and within 3" of a terrain feature, roll a dice. On a 4+, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the turn.
While this unit’s **Zarbag** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.
